Name: Demon Slayer Valley Babies

Description:
[center]﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/4qnFCXp.png[/img]﻿[/center][center][size=4]Now Your little ones can be carbon copies of Your Slayer Valley Spouse!
[/size]
. . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . .

[size=5][b]UPDATE: [/b]There are new Hairstyles and Outfits for your Babies!

[/b][size=4][b]

Light or Dark Skintones

Braid [b](Kyojuro Children)[/b]
Ruka [b](Kyojuro Children)[/b]
Pigtails
